g.title: EssentialTremor_QSP
g.text: Oscillator formulation: loop gain sets amplitude, loop delay sets frequency, loop topology sets the therapeutic ceiling
186 nodes · 18 clusters · gain-path (blue) / delay-path (orange) / topology-path (red) / drug (green) / endpoint (purple)

g.title: cluster_io
